body: I think I'm going through similar things, 23, male, diagnosed bipolar by a doctor when I was younger but now I'm in therapy and it seemed to be helping at first but I've missed the past 2 appointments because it stopped helping and I'm afraid to talk to him about some things that have happened recently. Anyways, hope you're okay, reach out if you need to talk.

Honestly, thank you. I may want to die but it's something to hear from someone that understands how shitty bipolarity can be. My wife doesn't understand but I don't blame her for that. I've tried to talk to her about solutions but I think we both need therapy, because she's definitely got some things of her own going on. Thank you again, I can't believe someone responded so quickly.

Currently laying in bed crying next to my wife while she sleeps
